text:
We have enjoyed dozens of delicious meals at Horseshoe, for special occasions as well as just because we were in the mood for their food. Sunday was my birthday and, given the present state of health affairs and our age, we wouldn't be going out to celebrate. So we opted for Horseshoe's curbside service. 

What a pleasure! It was easy to order; we called when we arrived; our food was brought out in minutes and placed in the open car trunk. Downside? The fragrance was almost too much to bear on the ride home. 

So the takeout process went smoothly, but you might wonder how the food fared by the time it got home. I ordered the ribs. They were falling-off-the-bone luscious: meaty,tender, juicy, and flavorful. And there was enough that we'll be enjoying them again tonight. Our loaded baked potatoes were perfectly roasted and expertly topped. The jalapeño corn muffins are complimentary when dining in, so we wanted (needed?) to order them separately.  At $1.99 for an order of those darling little muffins, it was totally worth it. Pretzel rolls were also part of the package, and we split one to try it. Really good, but we had so much food that we are saving them for sliders later this week. 

Since it was for a birthday, we had to have the best dessert in town: the s'mores skillet. The takeout version came in a foil pan instead of cast iron, but was as phenomenal as when dining inside the restaurant. Someone had thoughtfully written a note with heating directions, so when ready, we

My first time here... got the Bun Bo Hue and the Pork Vermicelli... both had a lack of flavor from what I'm use to. Very bland if you ask me.. there was some flavor don't get me wrong but it was delicious like other places I've been. This place as packed so maybe it's the dishes I selected.

Super delicious pad Thai and drunken noodles! Would recommend 10/10! The noodles were super juicy, plenty of protein and veggies, and tasted amazing. Loved the little bit of heat in the drunken noodles. So good!
Fresh! They even have Spam Musubi! Reminds me of Hawaii!! Amazing service too!! I highly recommended if you're a poke fan!!

Some fine moments for our dinner last evening, 2 couples on the deck lovely view beautiful weather.

Food ordered kept simple in light of the venue (big corporate owner), twas about old friends catching up.

Starter of dip and cornchips was okay, no rave comments. 

Drink service on the slow side.
Poor server could've sued for non support?
Too hard to get H2o for each of us? We asked twice, ditto beer refill, never did get the vino we were after , poor product knowledge possibly?
Wished the DRY pinot grigio, given an unbranded little teeny weeny  5 oz dispenser which was poured into glasses tableside when we really wished a proper 25 oz. LABELLED full unopened bottle.
Who knows what was served? only to say we didn't ask for another, as it seemed 'too difficult'.

Enjoying the ambience on the dexk outdoors with friends, hence food / drink felt secondary. A good night out.

No complaints about the 4 different MAINs or the shared salad family style; commercially acceptable / unremarkable.
My southern fish dish was bog standard catfish sliced breaded deep fried, w/ crispy potato fries and skinny slices of onion (fried) Good thing about that big green salad! ( though funnily enough someone tried to clear it away whilst I was still eating?)
Wife's blackened fish w dirty rice pronounced best dish of the lot, ate up every last morsel  unlike we 3, who pecked away and left lots.

An impressive new facility, huge restaurant on 3 floors built post Katrina, the whole area looks fabulous.
Delicious pizza. Fun family environment in the restaurant area. Local beers served which are awesome.
Worst place ever smh waited in line 35 min. And still didn't get food that night shift needs help  it's sad that. They don't even answer the phone when you. Call. I'm super disappointed

This was extremely deceiving for us. Yelp classifies this as Italian Mexican restaurant but does not indicate that this is an all vegan restaurant. 

We entered into the restaurant and greeted by a very nice waitress. She asks us if it's our first time and we tell her yes. She seats us, gives us menus, and proceeds to now tell us that it's a plant based restaurant. We felt it was too rude to leave now so we figured we give it a try. 

The menu (although it says plant based foods up top) says beef and chicken which was confusing.  But we thought, it's probably pretty good judging from the five star review. 

We got the beyond burger which was good. However the fried chicken and waffles (we ordered three orders) were not impressive. Waffles were cold on the inside and the sauce was sour. The "chicken" was a deep fried piece of cauliflower. One piece of cauliflower that's battered and deep fried. This was disappointing and cost $15.25 each.

Sorry, but I am not coming back nor recommending this establishment. I'm also curious how this place has a five star review.  I'd recommend the waitress to let the people know that this is a vegan restaurant upon the entering of the restaurant.

Horrible service, we first got here and sat down within seconds they were asking what we were going to drink, let alone we weren't even fully seated nor were able to see a drink menu. After this we ordered our food, I ordered shrimp tacos, and received some type of fish taco, NOT SHRIMP. My mother found a a piece of hair inside of her enchiladas, the manager tried to tell us that it was my moms hair. And to end it all, the waitress never came to check on our chips or salsa. Wouldn't recommend this place.

This is one of those bogus reviews about not getting to experience the place, so feel free to skip. I'm simply writing to voice my disappointment in the young female server manning the take-out window a couple of days ago. We heard the owner of Avenue Pub on a podcast about New Orleans, Beyond Bourbon Street, and walked 40 minutes to try it out on our last day in town. When we got to the window, the girl told us there would only be take out service. When I asked if I could use the bathroom (i'm 5 months pregnant), she said "i'll have to ask my manager." I kind of mumbled to my fiance despairingly that I really needed to use the bathroom before I eat, and she said something like "alrighty thanks bye!" and slammed the shutters in our face before she could a) ask her boss, b) see if we still wanted take out. It was really disappointing, especially after really looking forward to it. My recommendation is to hire more polite people to work your window and cut pregnant ladies a bathroom break.

They do the cheeseburger and chicken sandwich better than anyone else. Their cheeseburger was too real. I felt like I was eating a real cheeseburger. 

The chicken sandwich was yummy too. I also had the potatoes salad which was pretty good. With all the burger options I was sad to have tried only one but I think Three Dot Dash has a special place in veggie burger heaven.
I was skeptical about eating here because of the location but I am so happy I gave it a shot.  Delicious fresh sushi and the pork belly ramen was off the charts!

Stopped here on Thursday for the first time.  Called my order in once I got there.  My order of two sandwiches was ready in five minutes.  Super easy to pick up at the door.  My friend and I each got a pork sandwich.  We decided to sit at the picnic tables behind the restaurant since they were all empty and it was a beautiful day!  The sandwiches were really, really good!  Full of flavor and the small was just the right size for me.  On my next visit I want to try their cheesesteak!

Everyone has a different style of pizza, if you like thinner, Neapolitan style pizza, then this is the place for you! Made fresh to order delicious wood fired pizza. My go to is The San Gennaro or just the Margherita and add pepperoni. The best part is the olive oils you can add on the side. I live for the chili infused olive oil  There is parking which is great considering it's located off Demonbreun. No excuse to not check it out.

I went to the Village Pub for outdoor dining and the staff and food were both wonderful! My waitress was Christina and she was great. She was attentive and I always had a drink. She always made sure our table was ok. I got the hot wings and they were delicious! There was a lot of meat on my wings and they just came right off the bone. This experience was just splendid!

This place was such a great find! Indoor and outdoor seating, charming atmosphere on the cozy back patio. The staff is wonderful! And the food -- omg! From scratch cooking - everything was amazing! I am so glad I checked Yelp and tried this place on our first day and not at the end of the week!!
The wait is long. The staff hardly pays attention to their tables. And make sure you get your credit card back and you d ok not have additional charges the days after your visit.

First time customer - was excited about trying Mas Tacos and it did not disappoint in any way.  Tried one of everything!  The soup is so delicious.  All the tacos were great.  Highly recommend this place if you are in the area!  Can't wait to go again and again.
Great place.  Hole in the wall.  Always solid food options.  When I drive by there and don't stop to eat or have a beer, it kind of upsets me a bit.  Not many places make me feel that way.

Rather than accepting bowling reservations (which makes no sense, especially now) you are expected to show up and hang out for 2 extra hours, during which time you'll be invited to a dining area to wait.  This might seem reasonable until you encounter the strange, automated environment which only looks like a normal restaurant.  In fact you will be required to seat yourself, navigate an online menu and pay for your order, including tip, before you receive any type of human interaction.  Your food may or may not arrive on the first attempt but rest assured you'll be charged both times.  And there is literally NO checking back or ongoing service of any kind so tipping seems rather inappropriate.  This is an experience that should be represented as it is:  grossly overpriced, mediocre tasting fast food.

5/5 recommend visiting a location while you're in Nashville. There is pretty much always a long line, but the wait is completely worth it. All of us absolutely loved our food.

Recommend: chicken tenders in *HOT, pimento Mac and cheese, baked beans, and banana pudding. 

** HOT is great for someone who likes jalapeños, Red Hot, etc. Damn Hot is more of a habanero flavor.

This was my favorite dining spot while we were vacationing in Nashville. I had the tarragon pork chop. It was delicious. Dessert was pecan pie. My neighbors visited Nashville last month and went to Arnold's at my recommendation and loved it as much as we did. We are going back this October to see the Buccaneers play the Titans and I guarantee we will be back!

I've been looking for a good  Thai restaurant close to home and I'm so happy I finally found one. The menu is large, so there lots of selection for everyone. 

I got the drunken noodles and crab rangoons, both were amazing. The noodles are the perfect mix of sweet and spicy. Just a heads up, I love spice and medium spice level was still very spicy. So don't go overboard. 

Their lunch special is awesome! Large noodle dish, soup, and salad/ spring roll for $8.99. You can't beat that.

After an initial disappointing visit I revisited with some friends on a Friday at 8 pm. This experience was much better. The ribs this time were more like what I would expect. I didn't have the chicken this time but the brisket was moist and tender. Everyone enjoyed their food including my vegan wife. We'll be back

Came in on a Saturday night around 7pm - about a 30min. wait for 2. 
We ordered a couple drinks & the garlic bread appetizer. Drinks took a minute but app was out quick. Drinks (Julietta & Milano Mule) were good but nothing mind blowing. 
For dinner we got the chicken parmigiana & the squidink pasta with shrimp. Food was pretty good - could have used some more shrimp on the pasta. 
Overall I liked the place and would eat there again. It's definitely a more "casual" American/Italian place. 
2 drinks, 1 app, 2 entrees - $100/with tip.

Used the drive through to get Chicken Mc Nuggets and coke. Placed our order and got through without any issue.  The nuggets though had apparently been sitting as they weren't oil fresh and tasted MEH.

If I could give 0 stars I would. Worst experience ever. Husband and wife have zero customer service or even life skills. Edamame portion was small to start. Sushi chef was seen torching volcano roll with propane flame torch, and you could taste the propane on the poorly made volcano roll with sad shreds of imitation crab. The spicy tuna roll tasted rotten, when confronted wife "wait staff" she yelled for the husband whom came raging out flailing his arms yelling at us that his fish is fresh. He sniffed it and started shoveling it in his mouth, continuing to flail his arms and yell at us demanding his fish is fresh and it is us!!!! Never have I been so angry or frustrated during a dining experience! DO NOT GO HERE!!!!!!
Cool idea of doing create your own pizzas as quick service. Price point is good. Like that create your own pizza you can add as many toppings you want for one flat price.

If I'm eating pho, it's probably because I feel like crap: I'm either sick or hungover (or both! YOLO, am I right?) Pho is my medicine -- it clears my sinuses, it hydrates me, it nourishes me. It's like a big brothy, noodly Vietnamese hug in a bowl. On the day that I visited Pho Real, I was feeling a touch under the weather, so I could not wait to get my face all up in a bowl of pho ga (chicken pho).

Now, I've had some dang good pho in my life. I've grown up around Vietnamese communities in Southern California, so I've had the good stuff. The pho from Pho Real is some solidly good pho. I wouldn't hesitate to take a pho veteran to Pho Real, because the pho here is really good.

My go-to at any pho restaurant is pho ga. Pho Real shreds the chicken into thin slices, which makes a lot of sense because then you can pick it up easily with your chopsticks when you're picking up the rice noodles. Also, they give you a lot of rice noodles. A lot! Almost too much! But they also give you a lot of chicken broth, so it all evens out. When you order a bowl of pho, you're getting a healthy bowl of pho.

I got my pho to go. They separated the ingredients (rice noodles, bean sprouts, cilantro, green onion, Thai basil) from the broth in different containers. That was much appreciated, because it meant that the noodles were not overcooked during their journey from the restaurant to my home. When I got home, I dumped the ingredients into a big bowl, dumped the broth over everything, and then sp
The burger was good but the fries had 2 much pepper on em.  Overall it was a good place to eat at.

This is my first time at Devon's Seafood Grill and the food and service want the absolute best I've ever had. I'm very pleased with the service, Sinclair was FANTASTIC! He was very attentive and pleasant :-) I ordered the Calamari and Mixed Seafood Grill entree with the Sparkling Blackberry Martini. Everything was OUTSTANDING!!!!! I will be back each and every time I go to Philly! The best seafood restaurant in Philadelphia!

I have never been more revolted by a restaurant as much as I was on Tuesday. I came in around 2pm and I walked up to the counter. There was an Asian woman working and she was blowing her nose into a paper towel. And then WITHOUT WASHING HER HANDS turned around and asked for my order. I don't know about you but I don't want to get sick from someone being absolutely disgusting around my food. And then, as if this could get any more repulsive the cook there had a big beard and wasn't wearing a net. I don't want someone's hair getting in my food or drinks, and that's clearly violating the sanitisation laws that places that serve food have to follow. I was so appalled by all of the disgusting behaviours of the employees here that I walked out without ordering. I do not recommend coming here and I won't be for a long time.

Walked in and wasn't exactly sure what was going one with the strange layout. This place seemed authentic enough, but it most definitely missed the mark. We chose a steak burrito and a chorizo burrito and both were nothing to write home about. We had hoped for more traditional Mexican flavors that really pack a punch.

Our server was great but the adjacent server was talking about another staff member which made us feel uncomfortable. Other than that everything was great! Right down the street from the house soIt's a place that we will go to often
The food was good and the people that worked there were very nice. I had the Sesame Chicken lunch special with Egg Drop Soup. I would recommend it!
#1 place for ramen  I always get the Nami signature tonkotsu or jigoku ramen which is spicy  When I'm sad, drunk, sick or just craving for some delicious ramen, I go here
Elated to have a place that does tortas. Great service, even when its busy, never feel forgotten. Food is always delicious.

Definitely my favorite taco spot. The spicy pork and carne asada tacos are to die for! Their salsa verde is also amazing and i'm pretty picky when it comes to sauce. 

I knocked off one star because the owner or whoever was at the register of the gas station (that the taco shop is in) is a freaking weirdo. I went into the gas station to use the restroom and then went outside to order my tacos. As I stood in line with my cousin, we noticed the man at the register kept coming outside to stare at us... when we noticed him staring, we stared back. he then proceeds to go into the taco shop kitchen window to stare at us again as if we weren't gonna notice? As we were leaving he stood outside and watched us as we drove away. It made us really uncomfortable so now every time we come we refuse to go into that gas station. 
If the tacos weren't that good i'd never come back but they really are soooo delicious.

Worse service ever. Both servers had attitude.  Waiter slammed my plate in front of me my eggs plopped up off plate and landed back down on the plate. The lady that came to table to take order rolled her eyes at everything I asked for.... was very disappointed in service, food was good.

BWW popped up on my Facebook feed advertising their BOGO wings/drumsticks on Tue. and BOGO boneless wings on Thu.

I grabbed my hubs an order of 10 wings/drumsticks and ended up getting 20 as a result of the special. I don't know about you, wouldn't you rather pay half the price for double the quantity? 

We got 4 different flavors that I rated from #1 as my fav. #4 as least fav. 

1.) 5x Jammin' Jalapeño - Very nice & strong jalapeno flavor, too bad it wasn't nearly spicy enough!
2.) 5x Carribean Jerk - Smoky & sweet flavor, maybe a hint of allpice...?
3.) 5x Mango Habanero - On the sweet side.
4.) 5x Spicy Garlic - No spice.

My only disappointment is that none of the wings were spicy at all, so if you are going to label the flavors "spicy" or mango "habanaro" or  jammin' "jalapeño"...BRING ON THE HEAT, BABY! Nearly all of them were on the sweet side with a pinch of spice. 

I appreciated the fact they let us grab 4 different flavors to try. Next time we'll def. reorder Jammin' Jalapeño. 

With Covid-19, they weren't allowing any diners, yet, a couple days ago. They had their doors open to make the pickup process as contactless as possible. I called my order in with an accurate turnaround time of 20-25 min. They did forget celery and carrots, so had to remind them!

If you come here, you would be better off eating before you come.  The burger I had is literary the worst burger I've ever had, anywhere at anytime.  It was awful, I regretted eating but I was hungry at the time.  
The bar is big, with a decent selection, my only complaint is that they never update their offerings in untapped.
Clean healthy options and some comfort food options too. The girls at the front are always pleasant especially Natalia!!!

Love the top golf concept. Why wasn't I smart enough to come up with a sports bar/fun golf activity place?

This location runs really smoothly from the second you walk in. There are people who greet you and direct you. You can either do a reservation check in or put your name on the list. We had a reservation and the bay was ready within 10 min on a busy Saturday night. If you are VIP there is a separate accelerated process and even a red carpet when you get to your bay. May have to be my 2020 resolution to achieve that. 

The staff is super helpful and friendly to explain how things work and make sure you are having a good time. We had a fantastic time with drinks, food, and the music playing. At night the course lights up which is pretty darn cool. We could have stayed all night!

Wow this place is a must go to if you are in downtown st. Pete 

I spilt the avocado and toast and added an egg... best A&T I have ever had! 9.5 /10

The power bowl I ordered was so big I needed a box and a vegan heaven dish! Loaded with vegan egg, corn, quinoa, black beans, guacamole, and pico. 
Best vegan dish I have ever had 9.6/10 and I will be

The best place to have a Viet sandwich so far. I love the Viet Coffee they make too. However, you gotta wait a bit long for the food since they have to warm up the bread. Just call in and get your order ready before coming it would be better for you.

Decided to try something different for lunch in St. Louis. I walked in and was a bit confused as some people would go to the hostess stand to the left and some would go to the open area to the right. I went right and stood around waiting for them to get it together, finally someone said we will be right with you, which was not true. Finally, my to go order was taken. I figured it would take a while to prepare so I went outside for some fresh air. The team wore facial coverings, however the hand sanitizers had a funny smell to them, I recommend bringing your own. I ordered the Meet Me in St. Louie as it was mentioned that's one of the most popular calzones. I thought it was ok, I really think they should add the sauce to the inside. I'm glad I tried something new but I probably won't be back for a calzone. If I return I'll try a salad instead.

The food was phenomenal. My wife and I indulged; it was our anniversary. Got 2 apps, the bacon/quail and the herb gnocchi. Entrees were the pork loin and the duck'am. Chocolate torte for dessert. They were all fantastic. Service was prompt, professional and friendly. They did some great touches for the anniversary incl a card at the table and custom cocktails. Just great all around. Can't recommend highly enough! We have a new favorite Nashville restaurant!
Not from the area but I have to stop over when I'm in town. Lox bagel is served open face and is delicious. They also take cash app and Venmo that make it convenient for the customer.

Ordered last week and then again this week.It's been a pretty long time since I've ordered from here but figured why not try it again. One had half pepperoni half sausage and last night half sausage half plain and literally zero complaints. The pizza was great and the cheese fries were amazing! Ordered directly from their site in the afternoon was able to add delivery time it was perfect and on time! My reasoning for 4 stars and not 5, although I am sure we will be ordering again soon I can't get past the $2 delivery charge like is that for the driver or not? how much should I tip the driver?  Not paying an additional  $7 on top of my pizza that just doesn't  make sense. So just left me in a tipping dilemma....other than that pizza and fries rocked!

So I decided to wind down after work having Happy Hour alone.  Shout out to the bartender for making my Apple Martini just right!  I ordered the Crab Beignets and they are so delicious! I recommend these! They are lightly breaded, filled with crab stuffing and served on a bed of remoulade.  The "foodie" side of me is happy and satisfied.  No dinner entree tonight!  Stay tuned til next time......

This place does breakfast right!! If you go after 8:45 ish, expect a wait; however, you won't regret it!! They have in house smoked meats and sauces that are amazing! They also offer a generous meal to our service members returning home from deployments FOR FREE! The staff is always most friendly and knowledgeable on the menu and specialty items. And don't forget to let them know if it's your first time there for a special treat! :)

More like SALT. Yes lots of tasty options of ribs, pulled pork and they even have jackfruit pulled pork which was awesome... but the only thing I'm not stoked about is the amount of salt in everything. Like why am I so full and dehydrated off of a half rack of ribs? Oh because of the copious amounts of salt in all the portions to make you hella full even though the sizes are pretty small. Let's be real. I can knock back a full rack of ribs no problemo, but here I can barely ingest two ribs full of meat :(

I used to frequent this panera quite often and this was my first time back in awhile. In one word -- disappointed. I normally don't write reviews for place with counter service, but this experience was so odd that I had to. I walked up to the counter and stood there for 3 minutes while the lady behind the counter rummaged through bagels. After standing there for quite awhile she said she'd be with me in just a minute. After about another 3 minutes another woman came over and asked the first woman if I had been helped. When she replied no, this woman then turned to me and asked me the same question. When she took my order she was very short with me and looked annoyed. She failed to ask if my order was for here or to go and seemed annoyed when I asked her where I could pick up my food. Everyone who was working this morning just seemed annoyed and bothered -- maybe something was going on. Food was good as per usual, but the service was just a bit sad. Debating on whether or not to avoid this location in the future.

Delicious food and great atmosphere. Karli, one of their servers always has a smile and the best service to start the day. With so many great local options to choose from, the service definitely is what separates First Watch from the rest and makes them the best.

Ordered Ubereats for a special date night, said it was out for delivery 25 minutes later. Awesome- we live 6 minutes away. Well an hour after that I called and the lady that answered the phone rudely told me no one from Uber came to pick it up. Well on their Uber site it says it is NOT Uber delivery, it is employee delivered (same as Panera, so I thought no problem) I explained this to her and she told me simply that that was not going to happen. I was speechless. I finally got out my request for her to cancel my order (I'm not going to go pick it up after it's been sitting out for over an hour) I can't figure out why they wouldn't call me to tell me it wasn't picked up even though they marked it as out for delivery. Whatever. Won't go back or recommend.

Amazing tacos here! My favorite is al pastor Diablo tacos. The enchiladas, nachos, ceviche are all outstanding for a quick and inexpensive dinner. 
I really enjoy making this a weekly dinner spot!

Definitely a quality comfort food! The gods of burgers! Their patties are always juicy and well seasoned and the cheese is gooey! Ive never had a bad experience here. Oh and dont forget the fries! Its worth it!

Amazing restaurant and experience. Came here on a few recommendations during our vacation and we are so glad we did! Had the tuna appetizer and my husband and I both got the stuffed grouper. It was so delicious! Service was phenomenal. Wonderful and definitely recommend to anyone visiting SPB!

I'm eating at Zoe's Kitchen right now and have to say that the food is wonderful. They changed their menu and the chicken kabob is now juicy and freshly made. So I have to commend them for the changes.
Oh my gosh GOOOOOOD FOOD! Fresh, hot, delicious!  Really, this is delish. Did I mention it's good?  Cause it is.

Each time I visit Square One I'm always 100% satisfied! The waitresses/waiters are always super friendly and helpful when you're indecisive with what drink to order (because there's so many good ones to choose from). Their cucumber and jalapeño vodka are my go-tos. Just recently had their brunch and it was fantastic! Ordered the "Southern Breakfast" and will definitely order it again. I'm excited to come back this summer to enjoy the patio!

Visiting in from out of town and staying in the Drury Inn, we decided to order food to go and the young man on the phone was super polite, recommended different items to us, and was knowledgeable and quick! Definitely would recommended the city wings! Yum

Such a great local spot. The ladies running the place are so nice. Ordered the wing platter and it came with 2 sides.  The platter must of weighed 5lbs. The place is very clean welcoming.  

The chicken wings are freshly made to order and perfectly fried. Green beans have some pulled pork in them and the mac n cheese has those crunchy bits. 

Also got piece of choc cake, but that's for later so ill update the review when i eat that.

Suri's remains king. Even when Door Dash'd and semi-cold, it is THE ABSOLUTE BEST. As I'm no longer at Renown, it's been about 2 years since I've been in, which is a shame!! For a while, I was going once a week for lunch. I can report that in these past couple of years, the quality has not changed. My delivered meal tonight was the dinner of my dreams!!

Make a reservation either online or by calling. You may need to call a few days in advance. Otherwise you will need to stand in line to make a reservation and the wait may be two hours or longer. 

When you go the buffet, the servers on the line will get a plate and fill it for you, at each station. Don't forget to save room at the dessert bar. The cotton candy and chocolate fountain were my favorites.
Good food. Simple menu to order from with enough plenty of choices. Good service. I ordered the trifecta breakfast plate, which was good.

This is the best bakery in STL in my opinion. The bread and dessert they sell are unique and delicious. You can only get them at this place. I love all the special items they have and I love the owners too. Their foods are not too salty and too sweet, just right. I eat their bread everyday for breakfast and also dessert, panna cotta is fabulous!!

Perfect girly brunch spot near Broadway! This place is so cute and full of lots of instagrammable opportunities. Walking into this restaurant, I didn't have high expectations for the food because the standard Nashville restaurant that looks like this typically doesn't have great food. I was pleasantly surprised with our entire brunch! 

We started with a sea shell drink and Parmesan fries. Get those fries, they are perfectly crispy and the dipping sauce sets it over the edge. I had the Bay House Scramble and it was very filling! The star of the show was the Crab Cake Benedict. If you like eggs benny, get this entree.

The food was great as usual when we were there for lunch this past Wednesday. I am not sure if they were short of staff that day, but the service was not as top notch as in the past. The restaurant wasn't really busy.

Great place. Written reviews for it before. Every menu item is good if you like either Thai or sushi. Spend years going through the menu and have a ball. Order takeout though as they are pretty unorganized with their eat-in during COVID (despite being a 16-year customer I was treated pretty rudely by a waitress I've known for over 10 years all over a miscommunication about what seats were available. haven't been back due to how awkward and weird that was but I'll return sometime as I have been here many many times before and they know me by name)

Swung by here on a whim one cold COVID night. Luckily it was late enough that we were able to be seated with only a short wait. If you can snag a reservation that's probably the better bet. They have done a great job acclimating to covid restrictions. They've erected a row of outdoor structures/tents that are whimsically decorated as well as having additional outdoor tables with heaters available at each. 

We started with a few of their cocktails which are nicely done and quite elegant. For the food, we started with the crispy octopus and duck pappardelle pasta. I wasn't too impressed by the pasta, but the crispy octopus was a nice bite. The real highlights however were the spicy jawn pizza and the lamb shank. The pizza was very flavorful with a good crust-sauce ratio and if you like spicy meats this is the one to get! As for the braised lamb shank - bring your appetite because you get a very large, juicy hunk of meat that falls right off the bone it's so tender. 

Lastly, I really appreciated the service as our waiter was clearly busy but had a great tableside manner and gave us great advice on our menu choices. 

Overall, I had a great experience here. You still get a feel for the ambience despite the covid limitations and the food and cocktails are delicious. Great place for a date or a small group of friends/family.

Biscuit Love - I was so excited to have breakfast here on my trip to Nashville. If you're heading to the location in the Gulch, prepare to wait at least 20 minutes in line. The space on the inside is large, but crowded. The good news is that service is snappy - our food was ready before we even finished getting water and sitting down. We ordered churros to share - my first foray with chocolate gravy was AMAZING! I tried the East Nasty, voted best sandwich in America according to the menu (I'm gonna need sources to back that up), while my coworker had the Lily. My chicken was flavorful and juicy, but I wish kitchen staff had been a little more generous with the gravy and cheese. Overall, my East Nasty was essentially a chicken biscuit with egg and a dab of gravy. I much preferred my coworker's biscuit French toast - the lemon and blueberry were a fresh and tangy perfect pair, and the portion was big enough to share without hesitation. At the end of the day, BL gets 4/5 stars for me - I can't wait to go back and try something new on my next visit.

I am EXTREMELY disappointed with this location. I ordered to-go, and mistakenly trusted that my order would be fulfilled correctly. First, I got there and called that I was there for the curbside pickup, and proceeded to sit in my car for 8 minutes waiting for it to be brought out. After getting tired of waiting I went inside to find my order sitting at the to-go counter getting cold. I got the order and proceeded to go home. Keep in mind I drove over 45 minutes to get P.F. Chang's as this is the closest one to me. I get home, and find out that half of my rice is missing, and a couple of the entrees were wrong. But the best part of all is that they had the audacity to serve me this egg shell filled entree of pork fried rice. Every other scoop had a shell. Absolutely disgusting that this was packed up and sent home with me.
Easy to customize per person, and variety. Tried in winter and will be back in the future.

We LOVE Eegee's and frequent them around town. Today Dianna was the person who took our order, she was so extremely unfriendly that when I approached her I asked her if everything was ok and she made a comment about my mask. (I was wearing one, which I was putting on as I was standing in line. I was easily 10ft from any other customer and there are plexiglas walls  everywhere) I was not being rude or ignoring "the 'mask rule" but Dianna was clearly offended that I didn't walk in with my mask on, that she treated me so rudely I don't ever want to come back here and deal with this! The world is a hard place right now and I don't feel the need to be treated badly when I'm supporting a business!

I've had the dim sum on the westbank at Panda King hundreds of times and learned to love dim sum. When searching for great dim sum dishes you really want fresh ingredients. A friend and I came here a few weeks after opening. It seems that parking may be difficult but luckily, we found a spot right in front. The place is small and cute. The staff is friendly and very accommodating. We ordered tea and the table was very wobbly so the tea ended up spilling a few times. We ordered a lot of dishes for the both of us because we wanted to try everything.

We got the basil popcorn chicken, shumai, xiao long bao, steamed pork bao, salted fish chicken fried rice, and some beef dish. Everything was good and pretty standard. Everything came out hot and very promptly, we did not have to wait long. The salted fish chicken fried rice is pretty salty (hence the name) so i avoided that fish. Nevertheless everything else was enjoyable. 

There are some differences between this restaurant and Panda King on the westbank. Panda King offers push cart service, meaning people come by with hot carts and you can choose what you want from the selection they have in that cart. I do like this method because you can try something and if you like it then you can order it again when they come by a second time. Also, the carts keep the food very hot. I really like shrimp shumai so i wanted to try it at Dian Xin but they had the pork shumai only. However, this place offers the soup dumplings that everyone lov

I used to go to the Rai Rai Ramen in New Brunswick all the time back when I was in college with my friends. That location serves not only ramen but also Taiwanese appetizers and snacks. When one of my friend told mE that a Rai Rai Ramen was opening down here, I was pretty excited for it! However, I was a bit disappointed when I found out that this location doesn't have all the food they serve in the New Brunswick location. Nonetheless they stilll have good ramen! I always get the Chicken Katsu Curry Ramen. The chicken katsu is fried perfectly and served on the side to the curry flavored broth ramen. It is very important that the meat is served on the side so that it doesn't get soggy in the ramen as I've been to places before that serves it like that and it definitely ruins the taste. Aside from the chicken katsu ramen, I've gotten the mini chicken katsu curry rice and shoyu ramen combo before and that definitely fills you up. With the two mini together, I can't never finish the food! I usually just eat one and end up packing the other one home. The curry rice is a bit hot in my opinion since I don't usually eat spicy food, but it's still very good!

This Rai Rai location is easy to find and it is in a strip mall plaza next to other food options with plenty of parking, the owners are nice, service is pretty fast, and the bubble  tea here is decent too.

Overpriced and overly hyped up. This place is mediocre. Their food is good but not great. The price point is even worse. There salsa is decent but this place is just too expensive for what they have to offer.

This is a must eat when in New Orleans. The beignets are just that good. And the iced coffee is amazing too. Just what you need to quench your thirst. 

This locations line is not that long. The one in downtown will be much longer.

I had a really horrible experience with this place trying to get food for Cinco de Mayo. I had ordered online but didn't see the restaurant had canceled my order after I  had left the house and was on my way to pick it up. I mean, couldn't you at least text a notice . When I arrived there was nothing but chaos. No organization,  many angry people standing in line for long periods of time, some walking away with food that had been sitting for no telling how long. Not all of this can be blamed on covid People.  I was going to leave a review of one star then and there. I thought about and went back to give it a fair shake. 
Again, I feel like management is lacking. Not a great amount of responsiveness. We did have a good server. The margaritas were fantastic and the food pretty good. There just didn't seem to be anything that will draw me back in. I can get that same food or better from other places that make me feel more welcomed.
I got the surf and turf large and it is huge! It's my first time having a Po' Boy here so I have nothing to compare it too but it was good. I wish I had asked for hot sauce.
The food was okay. The sauce wasn't the best but it definitely wasn't bad. I was visit again but I'll stick to my usual crab place
I Order from here all the time- Love their house balsamic dressing! The chicken caecer wrap, Fresca salad, and Caprese salad are some of my favorites!
Vanessa was a phenomenal server, she anticipated our needs and helped customize our brunch in a very interesting way. I loved our food as well, the fried chicken was absolutely amazing.
This place is great. Best pizza in Queen Village. Staff is friendly, food is always good.

Had a great experience at Calebs this morning. We had a wait and the staff made sure to continually check on us and accommodate accordingly. I believe the hostesses name was Rebecca? and she was extremely helpful and made sure we had everything we needed. I will be coming back for sure. Food was great as well!!

Make sure to make a reservation! I made a reservation for Saturday night and was sat immediately. It was freezing at night so maybe bring a blanket as they don't have that many heaters. Food was excellent. I got the pasta with scallops and shrimp. Our waitress was so kind and very attentive. Would go again!

More than perfect in everything including taste, price, friendliness cleanliness everything 
Thank you so much

Disappointed, yet again. No sauce, no pickled veggies? Consistency is key when running a restaurant, or any business for that matter. We loved this place the first time we tried it last year, but every time since has been an incredible let down. The meat here is extremely fatty and often very burnt, but smothered in sauce in hopes that you won't notice. 
Also, try helping out when a customer doesn't know how to pronounce the menu items, instead of starting at them like they have 5 eyeballs! :)

These po'boys were the best meal we had in NOLA!  The beef with coffee bbq sauce was AMAZING and the grilled shrimp was great too (the shrimp po'boy reminded me of a banh mi sandwich).  Fresh and so flavorful.  We went to some fancy restaurants in NOLA but these po'boys were much more "WOW!"
Horrible service, drive thru is never fast service. Around 10pm you can wait in line forever waiting to get served. They leave the window and just stop working.

This is a hidden gem.  I had cooked something for dinner the other night and that prompted me to go search for korean food in my area.  It should be a dont miss if you are anywhere close.  We ordered the kimchi-jeon and the dolsot-bibimbap.  It was amazing!!  They bring some small plates to the table, fish cake slices, tofu, bean sprouts, and 2 kimchee dishes.  I was so stuffed I had to bring the rest home.  I cannot wait for lunch tomorrow.

I'm done going to this dump. We get 3 or 4 sandwiches every time. They haven't gotten the entire order correct since Morgan owned it. This time I go in and watch some girl pick up the garbage off the floor, throw it in the trash and start making a sub without changing her gloves. I told the cashier and he said" its ok, its not yours". Its somebodys.

It was my coworker's idea to come here for lunch with the team. The staff was friendly and they were happy to accommodate such a group (10 people). I have always been a fan of the soup dumplings so I was happy to enjoy their menu item. We each ordered something different and shared with the group. I feel like this is the best way to enjoy food personally. Risky but delicious!! Lol. No one got sick and I will definitely have to go back for their special price lunch menu. Plenty of food for less than $7!!

Decided to have a calm Sunday and go grab a quick bite with friends before we went to the movies in WestBank (I love the reclining seats but I digress). Now I will never pass the opportunity to have a bowl of Pho and heard nothing but great things about this spot.

Most proper places I've gone for a bowl will let you snag a large for $10 or less so I was pretty stoked you could have a large bowl with your choice of protein (or sans protein since they do have a Vegetarian option) for $9.95. I opted for brisket, flank, and rare steak. All the meat was cooked/served perfectly.

The broth was delicious and they served plenty of toppings for the table!

What I loved though was the choice of snagging a french roll (I call it a bolillo) for a buck. Never thought of dipping a french roll into the broth but my goodness was that genius.

Service was super quick and on-point. I highly recommend coming out to give Pho Hoa a chance.

If you're going with a large group y'all can pay individually at the front since that's where you check out.
They were rude and couldn't give me my order right. I asked for some ranch and he just gave me attitude saying he put us on the bag which he just gave me bbq sauce
This place is delicious! Best Cuban sandwich I've ever had. Highly recommend trying this out especially on a time crunch. Fast service and great food.

Really can't say why I haven't been here before considering how close I live to this place.

For a Tuesday night, this place was packed! (That is a good sign). We ordered three pizzas and the tiramisu as 'Take Out'. We enjoyed all that we ordered! Highly recommend the meatball pizza with the stuffed crusted filled with ricotta cheese. Tiramisu was one of the best I've had locally in a while.

This restaurant is BYOB and they offer legit wine glasses. No need to bring your own Wine lovers.

We look forward to returning for a dinner at night. Highly recommend!

We went to Chicken's Place in a Sunday for lunch. Our server, Becky, was so kind and our drinks were never empty. She recommended the brussels sprouts and they were amazing. The chicken was some of the best we've ever had. Definitely give this place a try!

I rarely leave negative comments and used to be such a fan of this place as a kid (being a tampa native). Was super excited to come back and get a sandwich with pastries but didn't even get the opportunity to get anything. Went after the lunch rush (so it wasn't super packed), stood in what i thought was the sandwich line...was told to stand to the side (so wouldn't block the door, that's understandable) and someone would be right with me...just to have 3 people walk into alessi (they literally just entered the place) and get served immediately before me...

Okay no big deal I have patience and they have a bakery. So i decided to try my luck over there. Stood in the actually line to get served...2 individuals received their request...as I approached the counter (next in line) the woman serving, walked away without sayin anything into the back. No biggie, maybe she needed to grab something? Waited another 10 min...never saw her again and the customers to the right of me were quickly being served by 2 other workers... At this point I just gave up, as it's been 30 min and I cant even get a request in. Super disappointed because I really wanted some of the desserts but guess they need to focus on being a bit more organized in helping customers. No doubt in my mind the food is good though...just hate when I have to fight for service :(

It's just ok, better than average but don't know if I'd return. I can cross it off my list now. The building is cool and a real eclectic vibe. The food was good but nothing you can't get anywhere else. I had the carpetbagger steak. Not the slightest bit unforgettable. Kids had bbq shrimp and shrimp creole and seemed to enjoy it ok. I'd say it is an overall average value and dining experience overall.  Bill was $185 for 5 of us, 5 entree's and one appetizer and no alcohol. You can do a lot better in Nola at that price without driving 20 min outside of the city.

Blush Tea and Coffee was a really lovely place to stop on a hot day. We ordered the Iced Dirty Chai and one of their signature Cloud teas. Here are my thoughts.. 

Atmosphere: 
This place was adorable. It was super cozy with tasteful furniture and great decor. One of my favorite things about the cafe itself was the abundance of ( purchasable) art hanging on the walls. Behind the counter, the wall was completely lined with tins filled with different teas. I thought that was a nice touch. In general, the ambiance is really nice!

Customer Service: 
The cashier was very kind and polite. Any questions we had were answered and we even got some recommendations. This definitely added to the positive and homey vibes of the cafe. 

The Drinks: 
My dirty chai was a recommendation and I can confirm it was indeed tasty. However I do feel that it was lacking some of its signature warm spice flavor. The latte itself could generally have a bit more flavor but I suppose everyone has different preferences on the strength of their coffee. The tea was also quite good but I found that it too was missing some of that signature Earl Gray flavor. This might have been due to the addition of lavender. In the end, both drinks were good but they probably could have pushed those flavors just a bit more. 

Pricing: 
The drinks ended up being about 4.50 each which some might find a bit steep but honestly you won't find many places with cheaper specialty coffee. You're paying for the good atmosphere , high

Not a pleasant birthday experience at all. 
There seems to be a common problem with this place and that is the seating. 

We had reservations and granted we were early and they said they couldn't seat us. We went to the bar area and had a drink. They bartenders are what gives them 1 of the stars. They were super nice and helpful. 

While at the bar we noticed two tables for six people were completely empty, so at 415 we went back up to the seating area with the rest of our party, thinking we would be seated soon. 
We walked up to the front desk and asked if they had any idea if we could be seated. They said at 4:30. 4:35 we were not seated yet so we asked again. And she said they didn't have any tables for us yet. My father in law went up to the front desk. He stated there were empty tables when we left the bar and if she has management he would like to talk to them about it. We were then seated and guess where - the table that we saw when we were at the bar and walked up front nearly 30 minutes before!  So, ridiculous. 
When we went to get our "sides" they were out of mashed potatoes, lobster bisque, vegetables, pasta, sushi, and greens. 
The table where they sat us, the chairs were extremely wobbly. And we were afraid they were going to break. 
I asked for lemon with my tea - did not get any and I didn't see the waitress again for 20 min to ask for it. 
Our empty plates during the entire visit were never picked up. 
The food was good.  I have to admit this is what gets them
Excellent food but not very good service. Very slow and not attentive. Reasonable price. Didn't take reservations for a large party but the wait isn't long.

NOT A FAN. We ordered food from The Row through Postmates for our staff lunch. Highly unimpressed. Their food was just "OK," I got the kale salad with blackened chicken - $20 for a mediocre salad with dried up kale and a dry piece of chicken. Their dressing was good, and let me tell you, this salad NEEDED it. I would not order from here again, I don't know if the quality would be any better going in to eat, but either way, I would NOT recommend!
OMG I love this pizza and the Greek salad. Wish I lived closer so I could walk there. Best salad dressing on the strip!!! Good pizza too!!
This place is amazing. We order from here all the time. The fact that their stars are this low is a real shame.

After the ownership had changed, food is not as great and lunch special is expensive considering that they took off the egg roll with it... I'm sorry, I've been coming to this place for almost 20years but the change of ownership don't make this place better but it got worse! They keep denying that the ownership was changed but I know Steve since I was little and him and his family don't own this place anymore... I have to go find a different place to eat Chinese food... smh

To start, I have no comment on the food, I do however have a comment about the customer service. I made a Valentines Day reservation at the beginning of January. February 12th rolls around and I get an email that morning stating that they could no longer honor my reservation due to new ownership. I've read online that they were closed for renovations and I just can't help but wonder why I only received a two day notice? I couldn't get a reservation anywhere else due to the late notice. I also saw that the ownership change happened at the beginning of January, shortly after I made the reservation. So they must have known they wouldn't be open and that they should notify current reservation holders.
Man it was great I'll definitely be back love the rice paper wraps and the peanut sause was  great place to figure out what you like and don't like if your new to vegan life

We literally just left Redwood Rotisserie and knew we had to leave a review. The food was so good, the service was on point and the atmosphere was super chill. We're in from out of town and we will absolutely come back to this place. You must come and give this place a try.

This local coffee shop is one of my favorite places to study! The business can be a little difficult to find if it's your first time since it's tucked away on the bottom corner of University Tower. I love ordering the simple 12 oz drip coffee with some sort of breakfast item. This past time I got the original avocado toast and it was pretty good! I have been wanting to try the "flight of three" off of the signature drinks side of the menu, but it has never seemed like the right time, so I plan on trying that soon (hopefully)!

This coffee shop was actually first started in 2016, so it's a fairly new local business that I highly recommend trying :)

I finally made my way into Salt +Smoke a few weeks ago, and liked it so much went back this past weekend.

I'm a huge brisket fan and they did not disappoint.  You get your choice of cut (flat cap or burnt ends) and it is very tender and very flavorful (but not too much) with very thick cuts.

The French fries are fresh cut and seasoned well. The remaining sides have proven great as I sampled from others plates.

They have a decent sized selection of appetizers, all that I have tried have been great.  The dry rubbed wings are super great!
This place used to be great now it's just an okay at best burger, long wait, good fries. I used to really like this place but won't be back.

We regularly choose Ruth Criss over other steak houses in most metro cities, but on the night of Dec 22 in Tampa we were not pleased. It was a busy night and the waiters were rushing. The dining room was very loud.  Our filet steaks arrived 5 minutes after our salad; but, we at least managed to eat 1/2 of the salad.  We couldn't wait to get home to relax, not doing it a Ruth Criss. Will try another steak house next time.
Haven't been here in years but it turned out to be my favorite restaurants ever!  Nice deserts and tasty sliders the food is top notch!
My boyfriend loved his salmon lox, it was made well. However my bagel was stale and hard as a rock

Yes!!!!! This place is so awesome! I love this place. I was a little nervous at first because it's a small place and I wasn't sure what would be on the menu. After walking in I realized the smaller venue was their thing! There we're so many people talking and having a great time and it smelled great! The garlic bread is TO DIE FOR! Our server Marissa was so awesome and so friendly! She made the experience so awesome! I can not explain how blessed I am to have found this restaurant. It is hands down one of the best places you will go in Reno! Oh yes yes yes yes yes! SO GOOD! GREAT SERVICE! I MAY STEAL THE RECIPE FOR THE GARLIC BREAD (don't tell them).

I don't know if St. Elmo owns this place or not.  But they say St. Elmo supplies all the beef for their burgers.  And the bartender told me St. Elmo is actually there for bookkeeping and general housekeeping every Thursday.  I'm not sure if this is true.  I'm Catholic.  Sounds true.  The Double Major was a fine cheeseburger.  As fine as I've had.  So fine.  But those blistered peppers are like candy.  The ponzu is super-citrus and precious.  Didn't want to see it go.  This is a really fine Indy spot.  You can get the shrimp cocktail here.

I picked up takeout breakfast on my way to the train station, turkey scrapple egg cheese on a bagel. The staff was so friendly and the food was hot and great! A tad bit greasy but all in all a damn good breakfast sandwich.

Couldn't decide on what to eat tonight so the girlfriend and I chose to check out Marcos pizza since receiving the menu in the mail. Figured we'd give it a shot. 

I called the order ahead for pickup. I placed the order for a Crispy chicken avocado salad and a personal buffalo chicken pizza. They stated 20-25 min. I have to say the food was just coming out when I was arriving. So that's a plus. During this pandemic no employees were wearing masks. Got the food home ready to eat I opened my salad to find out they gave me the wrong salad. They gave me the plain old crispy chicken salad which had bacon in it and my girlfriend cannot eat bacon. Which is why we ordered the one without. 

Upon playing my salad and removing the bacon off hers I started to eat. Only to see a dead bug or beetle of some sort in my salad. This completely turned us off and we could not even finish the salad. We didn't even get in two bits before we saw this. I would say something like that on a first experience is not a good start. Hopefully somehow they can make it right or refund the charge. I don't typically write negative reviews about a place and give them a few chances but this is where I draw the line with dead bugs in my meal. Back to one of the many other pizza places around. What a disappointment.

I've been meaning to go here since they opened.  Finally got a chance to take one of my friends out for their birthday.  This place very clean.  The ambiance is very nice.  They have a very nice menu with a lot of great selections.  The staff is very friendly.  Our host was a  name Dez who was awesome.  He knew when we needed refills and was very attentive to our party.  I highly recommend this place:

We really enjoyed our visit. Our cheeseburgers were exceptional - juicy and perfectly cooked. The service was exceptional. Our bartender was Stephanie. She took great care of us. Stephanie continually checked on us. Casey, the GM,  also checked on us frequently. All the folks there were super nice. The Courtyard looked enticing - maybe next trip to NOLA in the spring. We will be back!

They're always so busy and I was on my run back home and there wasn't a lot of people in line so I finally ran in and was able to get some Sunday funday treats. The macaroons have dense cool fillings and are light and perfect. The desserts are picture perfect. And the king cake tarte scored high marks in my book. I kept the baby.

With everything going on with COVID-19 we need to support our locally owned bars and restaurants.  Saguaro Corners is serving all the food on the menu as takeout plus meal packages.  They are also filling growlers of their draft beers.
Wish I could give it zero stars. They don't season the meat in their ground beef tacos and every other dish we ordered was cold and bland tasting.

If you are looking for quality sushi in the St. Louis area, this is the place to be. We ordered the Isaan hamachi, the shima aji sashimi and the laarb as well as the Hokkaido scallops and flounder nigiri. Everything was so fresh and delicious, but if I had to pick the top two must gets: isaan hamachi and shima aji sashimi. Thought the prices were definitely higher than average, the price definitely matches with the quality of the food. Would definitely come back again.

The original location is in the Westbank and I am so glad they opened a location in Metairie! We ordered a bunch of stuff and shared. I've always been a fan of the sea salt white fish sashimi, seafood kimchi udon and the cowboy roll. The sashimi was fresh and perfectly cut. We tried the  lemon magic roll (which has chopped scallops in it) and some other stuff. Definitely give this place a try if you haven't already!

One of the best true Mexican eateries  I've had in a long time! Food was great and fresh! Amazing guacamole and home made chips! The shrimp tacos were amazing and the Al Pastor quesadilla is a now favorite of mine!! Also our waitress Diana was great ! We will be back

Delicious food, with fresh ingredients.
What a treat we had at Jaco's today! 
We had the Santa Fe short rib burrito and the Adobo chicken bowl, homemade chips and salsa and fresh guacamole. 
Highly recommended!

So much love for this place. As soon as the door opens you've traveled across the Atlantic and you're in a Parisian bistro. The decor and vibe are on point. It's owned and staffed by a french family, son at the bar, mother serving tables and father preparing delicious authentic food. The wine is amazing and reasonably priced. 
Definitely worth checking out and I'll be back!

The best service and quality around!!! The best Indian food I've ever had. The owner is super friendly and attentive. He always anticipates your needs before you even know you need anything. Highly recommend!!
Incredible drinks, excellent service, and a view that can't be beat. Stop in for a few cocktails around sunset to start off a great night.

I absolutely LOVE this place! If I lived in the area, I would be a regular FOR SURE. I was only in town for a week and I ate here twice (once for dinner and another for lunch on a different day.) Where do I begin?! 

Let's talk about the food first. It was AMAZING. I had the fried mozzarella appetizer. (See one of my pics.) It was the best version of "mozzarella sticks" I've ever had. I also loved that it wasn't in a stick shape but more like a flat circle. Their marinara sauce is really yummy too! I also had the Parm fries. I could not stop eating them! Then, they had peanut butter to go in their shake?! I always give extra points to restaurants that have a few extra flavors than the traditional chocolate, strawberry, vanilla. 

Okay, I'm a sauce girl. So, when I found out they have like 8 different sauces you can have for no additional charge, I was highly impressed. My favorite was their Diablo Sauce sauce. It was super flavorful. If you're not a spicy person their garlic aioli was also tasty too. I then had a salad for dinner one night and a burger for lunch a different day. Both were AWESOME. (Pretty much I'm running out of descriptive words to say this place is one of the best burger places I've ever had.)

Let's talk about the decor. I thought the women's bathroom was so cute! I know it's random, but the details matter to me and you could tell someone thought about the ambiance they wanted in this place. I also loved that the vibe of the place was different depending o

Thought this would be just another typical burger place but when I got the Texas burger, it changed my mind. If you get it, get the hot tots as the side. To finish things off, the white chocolate strawberry shake is amazing!

Today I stepped in to a cozy, 18th century once-operating inn in the quaint town of Kimberton. I felt immediately taken back in time.

We were greeted by a manager who walked us through their Sunday brunch offerings. We were alerted that their brunch is a full-service, sit-down operation, with no a la carte offerings. We came with appetites and happily accepted!

We were seated and promptly greeted by an upscale, uniformed wait staff who offered us tea or freshly squeezed orange juice. We opted for the orange juice and it was truly the best I've ever had; it was so fresh and tasty. We were also brought a basket of house-made biscuits and sticky buns. The biscuits were divine (it's one of my favorite foods, so I'm a tough critic!).

For appetizers, I had the gronola with fresh fruit and my boyfriend had the "Best Salad You'll Ever Have". With such a confident title, we were anxious to see if it was aptly named. He said it lived up to its title.

For entrees, I had the vanilla French toast with fresh fruit and a side of bacon, and my boyfriend had the Eggs Benedict with home fries. Unfortunately, he said the muffin was a little burned and the overall taste left something to be desired.

The wait staff were friendly and very accommodating; your water glass will be refilled the moment it touches your lips.

For $26 each, I felt that we were given a good value.

Come here if you'd like an upscale, but not stuffy atmosphere, on the outskirts of Phoenixville.

I just pick up my weekly chicken cheese steak.
 Today I was dessipointed' not only the onions  where no cook enough, the mayonaise was on the top of the sandwich which cause the wrap to become so messy... and on top of that not even paper towels was giving to me. I ask for a side of mayonaise,  no where to be find.
And the young lady was kind of cold with a 30% tip
Sorry about this review but  I feel like you should be aware of this experience... i will try again

I have been coming here since it's opened and I have to write a review. The evening shift the past month has been very unprofessional. The food and service always lacks when they are working. 

Also- why are you using plastics when you dine in?

Limited menu. Ordered 
Full rack o Ribs - excellent! 

Sides
Mac and bacon
Candied bacon
I consider myself a Mac n cheese connoisseur. It was a little too thick but a solid contender. The candied bacon was winner - only 2 slices served so order accordingly. 

Would definitely return on next visit to St. Louis area.

I believe this is the very first Habit location and actually the one I visit most because they have never failed to make my order right. My go to remains to be a char burger with cheese and avocado. Cheese, avocado, and bacon are extras but a good note to have is that subbing to get sourdough isnt! This means you can create a smaller version of their Santa Barbara char burger :) also enjoy their fries and I always ask for a side of their housemate thousand island to dip. I see the habit as a burger option to go with when I want something less on the heavy late night grease that in n out can be (even though I love in n out too). Hoping to try some of their more unique offerings like tempura green beans and salads in the future.

The gyoza pork dumplings and General Tso's chicken were phenomenal!

My wife had the hibachi steak & shrimp and said it was delicious.  

It was my first attempt at sushi and I was impressed.

Service was fast and friendly.

The first time I reviewed this place it was great.Last nite not so good. The Chicken Katsudon was over cooked and dry. Server didn't offer my money back. She could of cared less. All I can say is I'm not going back.

Pros:
-Good parking
-Friendly service
-Decent tasting food


Cons:
-Place feels tired (cutlery worn out, menu broken)
-Not much meat or veg in the sauce (which came in a decent size serving, but was mainly sauce).

Had the curry chicken, Navratan Korma, butter chicken, aloo Goni, samosas and naan. Everything was tasty, but nothing spectacular.

It's the middle of quarantine; however, I was still super determined to try this little joint. Luckily, I was able to order very easily online and pick my pick up time. Because of this, the food was still nice and hot by the time I picked it up and drove back home to quarantine. I ordered the Big Thai wrap with the side salad. The wrap was very filling and super flavorful. From the first bite, I was in love! Chicken was well cooked and the flavors just fit together so nicely. Normally, I am a spice fan and I add hot sauce to everything, but this wrap didn't even need it! The salad was very refreshing too! I am so glad I was able to try this amazing little gem in St. Louis! Stay open and strong during this time! You folks make some incredible food :)

I ordered a small cheesesteak and wedding soup. I expected a 6" steak and was surprised to receive a larger one. The roll was skinnier but delicious  they did not skimp on the meat. The only ding was that the soup was not heated.  I put it in the fridge and will have another lunch. It looks yummy.
Always good never had a bad meal even during shutdown takeout was awesome as well. Highly recommended
My partner got the brisket which was okay and I got half a slap of ribs. The ribs are to die for. It fell off the bone an so tender. There was no need to add any sauce to it.

This was the first time I tried the Daiwa in Metairie and it was so good!! Some may think it's pricy, but I think the quality and the freshness of the rolls are worth the price. The tiger eye roll was definitely one of the best rolls I've ever eaten!

I really like this place. Food is good and greasy which is what I want from this genre of restaurant and the milkshakes are awesome. 

This is in addition to the decor which is spot on 50s. A really good place for a casual date night or family night out. 

The one thing to be careful of is that it can have a really long wait during rush hours so I suggest calling ahead and asking how long the wait is before going over.

Food was delicious. We had the ham/cheese/mush omelette, Florentine crepe, and king cake French toast - very good. Also had mimosas and the Irish coffee. The wait wasn't bad, we got on the wait list as they didn't take reservations. The service was great also.
